en.headline: 4 own commits plus 7 automated commits across three repositories
en.summary: **4 own commits** were recorded across three repositories, alongside 7 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, the user tightened `AGENTS.md`, moved model-selection testing notes into `MODELS.md`, and added Xiaohongshu Dots as a fallback at the end of the daily-report chain. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, the user documented V2 plugin and tool-registration testing and corrected two inaccuracies about schema and Registration. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management`, the user added minimal npm installation instructions and the npm package file tree to the README. The user opened or closed **1 issue**: `openchamber/openchamber` issue #5935, “[Bug] Settings > MCP omits the Console MCP server that OpenCode adds at runtime”, which remains open with no comments. No pull requests, reviews, releases, or discussions were recorded.

zh.headline: 4 次本人提交，另有 7 次自动提交，分布于三个仓库
